title: 第23章 古玩街淘宝第24章 古玩套路深
content_zh:
远离都市喧嚣，环境清幽，空气清新，别墅间隔近百米，没有外人打扰，紫玄山庄的别墅果真不错，只是一个人住这么大别墅是不是太浪费了些。
远眺紫金山，俯瞰玄武湖，莫轻舞静静欣赏着眼前的六号别墅，没有显赫的身份和地位，恐怕花费多少钱也无法在紫玄山庄购买别墅，也不知道江凡是怎么住进紫玄山庄豪宅。
客厅的家电配套相当齐全，液晶电视、DVD、音箱、唱片机等等，苹果、葡萄、哈密瓜等水果拼了个果盘，莫轻舞悠闲坐在客厅沙发看电影，东道主江凡则亲自下厨招待两位贵宾。
没多久，考完英语六级的李子茜，驾驶着红色法拉利跑车来到苍玄小院，送了台IBM顶配笔记本电脑作为乔迁之喜，国内售价高达元，美利坚售价可能只有6800……
两女在客厅有说有笑聊天，江凡在厨房忙的热火朝天，忙活了两个多小时，一盘盘精致日本料理端上餐桌，寿司、刺身、天妇罗、蒲烧鳗等，特意准备了几瓶日本清酒。
“上得了厅堂，下得了厨房；守得住寂寞，创得了辉煌！”
李子茜赞赏竖起大拇指，长得很帅，厨艺很棒，战力很强，耐得住寂寞，又不沾花惹草，不得不说江凡是个很完美的男人！
“确实，如此优秀的男人，又没做过什么伤天害理缺德事，老天真是不长眼。”
莫轻舞笑着说道，玄武湖公园那么多人，雷电却只劈了江凡一人，人品也是没谁了。
两女也不客气，筷子夹起一块三文鱼寿司，蘸了下佐料，海苔酥脆，米饭绵软，鱼肉鲜嫩多汁，层次丰富的口感在嘴里完美交融，每一口都是味觉极致享受，令人回味无穷。
厉害，厨艺真心没得说，两女随后夹起刺身盘里的生鱼片，蘸了下芥末佐料，辛辣、咸鲜、鲜美，鱼肉鲜嫩爽滑，入口即化，咀嚼间满口余香，令人欲罢不能。
蒲烧鳗更是一口入魂，酱汁浓郁，有股特殊的芳香，鱼肉外焦里嫩，醇厚而鲜美，还很Q弹，再喝上一口清酒，闭上眼睛，简直就是味蕾的极致享受。
“江凡，商量个事，那五万块钱不用还了，就当我的餐费，一次一千，怎么样？”
李子茜眉开眼笑看向江凡，以前去日本旅游时候品尝过不少高档日料餐厅，可与江凡做的日料比起来，简直就是天壤之别！
“我那一万块钱也不用还了，子茜来吃大餐的时候喊上我。”
莫轻舞笑着说道，本以为江凡做的日料卖相不错，可味道简直甩日料天花板松川餐厅几十条街！
开什么玩笑，江凡每天忙于修炼，一天也就早晚两顿饭，或是吃水果，或是泡面，或是到山下餐厅，自己都懒得做饭，哪有功夫给两个债主做饭，想了想，言不由衷说道：“一个月最多一次，一人餐费两千！”
“一顿饭四千，你怎么不去抢？”
李子茜恨不得拿起酒杯砸向江凡，你是不是在帝豪KTV敲诈勒索上瘾了，今天敲诈到姐头上，哪天会不会敲诈到紫菱头上！
“也是，两千块钱也太看不起我们李富婆，那你的餐费就五千吧。”

呵呵，人这么白净，心却是黑的，姐真谢谢你看得起姐，李子茜玩味看向黑心奸商江凡，好奇问道：“黑凡，你以后要是开了中医诊所，没个几十万是不是看不了病？”
黑凡，莫轻舞忍不住捧腹大笑，这外号起的也太贴切了，之前在学校时，江凡可是不要脸的想一顿大餐抵销她那一万块钱的债务！
“医者仁心，怎么说本人也是优秀的共青团员，怎么可能干出见死不救的事！”
江凡信誓旦旦看向两位美女，穷人肯定是救的，富人钱不到位肯定见死不救，想起前两天在竹心湖遇到唐装老者，随即好奇问道：“你们有谁认识孟德庭吗？”
“听过，不太了解，金陵孟家好像是苏村真正的话事人。”
李子茜诧异看向江凡，怎么突然转移话题到孟家什么，随即看向莫轻舞，“轻舞，你应该对孟家挺熟悉吧？”
“子茜说的确实不错，金陵孟家是苏村真正的话事人，孟家在长三角的产业不少于百亿，黑白两道有着巨大影响力，而孟德庭是孟家老家主，据说……”
莫轻舞手指别墅天花板，诧异看向江凡，好奇问道：“怎么，你认识孟德庭？”
好吧，华夏果真卧虎藏龙，数千年的中庸之道，数千年的王朝更迭，又经历特殊时代，各大世家深得蛰伏之道，明哲保身，那是藏的一个比一个深！
见两女好奇的目光，江凡笑着说道：“前几天在竹心湖公园偶遇，没想到是条大鱼”
，咳咳，这就有些尴尬了，一时心直口快，怎么口吐真言，说出真心话，立即尴尬解释：“没想到和蔼可亲的老人却身份如此显赫，只是帮了个小忙，送了我一张百元大钞。”
呵呵，李子茜、莫轻舞一阵冷笑，一顿大餐敢敲诈熟人数千元，一张百元大钞能让黑凡出手帮忙，那还对得起大鱼的身价嘛，两女心有灵犀的异口同声问道：“黑凡，你打算如何敲诈孟家呢？”
这章没有结束，请点击下一页继续阅读！
“本人姓江，名凡，字苍玄！
医者仁心，本人怎么可能敲诈一位和蔼可亲的老人呢？”
江凡义正言辞看向两女，见两女一副信你个鬼的神情，人与人之间的信任呢，好吧，无奈说道：“真的没有敲诈孟家，只是药方里多了几株名贵，不，天价药材。”
黑凡果真是名不虚传，要是有钱人的天价诊金没到账，那黑凡真的可能会见死不救，李子茜默默同情孟家三秒，黑凡开出的不是天价药材，而是极难购买到的珍稀药材，转手再以宇宙价卖出！
莫轻舞身体微微颤抖，孟德庭的身份极为显赫，什么样全球名医找不到，疾病无法治愈，却求到江凡头上，那江凡是否可以……
一顿大餐吃的颇为尽兴，李富婆那是真的无利不起早，送了一台IBM笔记本作为乔迁之喜，临走时邀请江凡明天去朝天门古玩市场逛逛，李家老爷子在八月份过七十大寿，让江凡在古玩街帮忙淘个朱元璋御用之物！
哥去大英博物馆或冬宫博物馆偷绝世珍品得了，好吧，李富婆也算为江凡打开赚钱的思路，有神识这个超级外挂，有事没事常去古玩街逛逛，别人那是淘宝，江凡那是真的捡漏，以后也不用为缺钱发愁！

不对，人有多大胆，地有多大产，江凡怎么能把思想局限在古玩街，长安、洛阳、金陵、燕京、汴京、临安、商都等等，这些古都地下不知道埋葬多少金银珠宝和古玩字画，，，

content_en:
Away from the hustle and bustle of the city, the environment is quiet, the air is fresh, the villas are nearly a hundred meters apart, and there are no outsiders to disturb them. The villas in Zixuan Villa are really good, but it is too wasteful to live in such a large villa alone.
Looking at Zijin Mountain and Xuanwu Lake, Mo Qingwu quietly admired Villa No. 6 in front of her. Without a prominent identity or status, she probably wouldn't be able to buy a villa in Zixuan Villa no matter how much money she spent. She didn't know how Jiang Fan could live in the mansion in Zixuan Villa.
The living room is fully equipped with household appliances, such as LCD TV, DVD, speakers, record players, etc. There is a fruit plate with apples, grapes, cantaloupe and other fruits. Mo Qingwu sits leisurely on the sofa in the living room and watches a movie, while the host Jiang Fan personally cooks to entertain the two distinguished guests.
Not long after, Li Ziqian, who had finished her CET-6 exam, drove a red Ferrari sports car to Cangxuan Small Courtyard and gave her a top-of-the-line IBM laptop as a housewarming gift. The price in China is as high as 3,000 yuan, but in the United States, the price may be only 6,800...
The two women were chatting and laughing in the living room, while Jiang Fan was busy in the kitchen. After working for more than two hours, plates of exquisite Japanese food were brought to the table, including sushi, sashimi, tempura, kabayaki eel, etc. Several bottles of Japanese sake were specially prepared.
"If you can go to the hall, you can go to the kitchen; if you can guard your loneliness, you can achieve brilliance!"
Li Ziqian gave him a thumbs up in appreciation. He is very handsome, has great cooking skills, is very strong in combat, can endure loneliness, and does not flirt with women. I have to say that Jiang Fan is a perfect man!
"Indeed, such an outstanding man has never done anything harmful or immoral. God is really short-sighted."
Mo Qingwu said with a smile, there were so many people in Xuanwu Lake Park, but the thunder and lightning only struck Jiang Fan, and his character was gone.
The two women were not polite. They picked up a piece of salmon sushi with their chopsticks and dipped it in the condiments. The seaweed was crispy, the rice was soft, the fish was tender and juicy, and the rich textures blended perfectly in the mouth. Every bite was an ultimate enjoyment for the taste, leaving people with endless aftertaste.
The two women picked up the sashimi from the sashimi plate and dipped it in the mustard condiment. It was spicy, salty, and delicious. The fish was tender and smooth and melted in your mouth. The lingering aroma was lingering in your mouth when you chewed it, making you want to stop eating.
The kabayaki eel is even more soul-stirring in one bite. The sauce is rich and has a special aroma. The fish is charred on the outside and tender on the inside. It is mellow and delicious, and very chewy. Take a sip of sake and close your eyes. It is simply the ultimate enjoyment for your taste buds.
"Jiang Fan, let's discuss something. You don't have to pay back the 50,000 yuan. You can use it as my meal expenses, one thousand at a time. How about that?"
Li Ziqian looked at Jiang Fan with a smile. She had tasted many high-end Japanese restaurants when she traveled to Japan, but compared with the Japanese food made by Jiang Fan, it was a world of difference!
"I don't have to pay back the ten thousand yuan. Zi Qian calls me when she comes to have a big dinner."
Mo Qingwu said with a smile, she thought the Japanese food made by Jiang Fan would sell well, but the taste was simply higher than the Japanese food ceiling of Songchuan Restaurant dozens of blocks away!
What a joke, Jiang Fan is busy practicing every day. He only has two meals a day, morning and evening, either eating fruit, instant noodles, or going to the restaurant at the foot of the mountain. He is too lazy to cook, so how can he have time to cook for his two creditors? After thinking about it, he said insincerely: "No more than once a month, and the meal costs two thousand per person!"
"A meal costs four thousand, why don't you go grab it?"
Li Ziqian wanted to pick up the wine glass and throw it at Jiang Fan. Are you addicted to extortion at Dihao KTV? If you blackmailed your sister today, will you blackmail Ziling one day?
"Yes, two thousand yuan is too much to look down on our rich wife Li, so your meal expenses should be five thousand."
Haha, you are so fair, but you have a dark heart. Sister, thank you for looking up to me. Li Ziqian looked at the black-hearted profiteer Jiang Fan playfully, and asked curiously: "Hei Fan, if you open a traditional Chinese medicine clinic in the future, won't you be able to treat the disease if you don't have hundreds of thousands?"
Hei Fan, Mo Qingwu couldn't help but burst into laughter, this nickname was alsoIt's so appropriate. When she was in school, Jiang Fan shamelessly wanted to have a big meal to offset her 10,000 yuan debt!
"The doctor is kind-hearted, but he is also an excellent member of the Communist Youth League, so how could he do such a thing as to ignore death!"
Jiang Fan looked at the two beauties and vowed that the poor would definitely be saved, but the rich would definitely die without saving them if they didn't have enough money. He remembered the old man in Tang suit he met at Zhuxin Lake two days ago, and then asked out of curiosity: "Do any of you know Meng Deting?"
"I've heard of it, but I don't know much about it. The Meng family of Jinling seems to be the real talkative people in Su Village."
Li Ziqian looked at Jiang Fan in surprise, why did he suddenly change the topic to the Meng family? Then she looked at Mo Qingwu, "Qingwu, you should be familiar with the Meng family, right?"
"What Zi Qian said is indeed true. The Meng family of Jinling is the real talker in Su Village. The Meng family's property in the Yangtze River Delta is no less than 10 billion. The black and white circles have huge influence. And Meng Deting is the old head of the Meng family. It is said..."
Mo Qingwu pointed at the ceiling of the villa, looked at Jiang Fan in surprise, and asked curiously: "What, do you know Meng Deting?"
Well, China is really crouching tiger, hidden dragon. Thousands of years of golden mean, thousands of years of dynasty changes, and special times. The major families have learned the secret of dormancy and wisely protect themselves. Each one has hidden it deeper than the last!
Seeing the curious eyes of the two women, Jiang Fan said with a smile: "I met him by chance at Zhuxin Lake Park a few days ago. I didn't expect it to be a big fish."
, ahem, this is a bit embarrassing. I was so outspoken at the moment, how could I speak the truth, and immediately explained in embarrassment: "I didn't expect that the amiable old man has such a prominent status. He just did a small favor and gave me a hundred-dollar bill."
Haha, Li Ziqian and Mo Qingwu sneered. They dared to extort thousands of dollars from an acquaintance over a big meal. A hundred-dollar bill can make Hei Fan help. How can it be worthy of Da Yu’s worth? The two women asked in unison, "Hei Fan, how are you going to blackmail the Meng family?"
This chapter is not over, please click on the next page to continue reading!
"My surname is Jiang, my given name is Fan, my courtesy name is Cangxuan!
The doctor is kind-hearted, how could I possibly blackmail an amiable old man? "
Jiang Fan looked at the two women righteously and saw that they looked like they believed you. What about the trust between people? Well, he said helplessly: "I really didn't blackmail the Meng family. It's just that there were a few precious, no, sky-high-priced medicinal materials in the prescription."
Hei Fan really lived up to his reputation. If the rich people's sky-high medical fees were not paid, then Hei Fan might really die without saving anything. Li Ziqian silently sympathized with the Meng family for three seconds. What Hei Fan prescribed was not sky-high-priced medicinal materials, but rare medicinal materials that were extremely difficult to buy, and then sold them at cosmic prices!
Mo Qingwu's body trembled slightly. Meng Deting's identity was extremely prominent. How could a world-famous doctor not be able to find a disease that could not be cured, but he was praying to Jiang Fan? Can Jiang Fan...
They had a great meal. Rich Mrs. Li really couldn't afford to go early, so she gave her an IBM laptop as a housewarming gift. Before she left, she invited Jiang Fan to go shopping at the Chaotianmen Antique Market tomorrow. The old man of the Li family celebrated his 70th birthday in August, so he asked Jiang Fan to help find some items for Zhu Yuanzhang's royal family in the antique street!
My brother went to the British Museum or the Hermitage Museum to steal unparalleled treasures. Well, Mrs. Li can be regarded as opening up the idea of ​​​​making money for Jiang Fan. With the super cheat of Divine Sense, he often goes to the antique street when he has nothing to do. Others are just Taobao, but Jiang Fan is really picking up things, and he will not have to worry about lack of money in the future!
No, no matter how bold the people are and how rich the land is, how could Jiang Fan limit his thoughts to antique streets, Chang'an, Luoyang, Jinling, Yanjing, Bianjing, Lin'an, Shangdu, etc. There are countless gold and silver jewelry and antique calligraphy and paintings buried underground in these ancient capitals.
